Subject: Quickstart CTA: interested in guided quickstart + tech deep dive

Hi Neha,

I used the quickstart guide in the docs and got a PoC running — thanks for making that so straightforward. We’re BuildBox (small ML infra team), and we’d like a guided quickstart session that includes:
- a short walkthrough of the docs quickstart for our engineers,
- a technical deep-dive on deployment options (private vs dedicated),
- integration patterns for streaming and KV cache.

Can you connect us with someone engineering-focused? Prefer mornings next week (Wed/Thu) PST. I’ll be joined by Lina Park (lina@buildbox.ai).

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Head of Engineering
BuildBox

Hi Tom — great to hear you got the quickstart running. I’ll set up a guided session and loop in Marcus (our solutions engineer) to cover the technical bits.

Available slots (PST):
- Wed Jul 8, 11:00am–11:45am PST
- Wed Jul 8, 2:00pm–2:45pm PST
- Thu Jul 9, 9:00am–9:45am PST

If any of those work, reply with a preferred slot and I’ll send a calendar invite. If you want to pick directly, you can use my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/neha-technical-demo

Prep for the call (quick):
- A 10–15 line example prompt or two you plan to use
- Expected QPS / concurrency for inference
- Any compliance/network constraints (VPC/on-prem)

I’ve copied Marcus to cover model/throughput recommendations.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
